english: Bayyu belongs to Bahr el Ghazal, a country of swamps and ironstone plateaus in northwestern South Sudan. The regional name means sea of gazelles. Dinka communities combine cattle herding with subsistence farming, alongside Luwo and Fartit peoples.
simp_chinese: 巴尤属于南苏丹西北部沼泽与铁石高原地域加扎勒河地区。地域名意为瞪羚之海。丁卡社群结合养牛和自给农业，与卢沃及法尔蒂特人共同生活。

sources.title: Bahr el Ghazal (region of South Sudan)

english: Baza, known as Basti in antiquity, was founded by Iberians in the fourth century BCE and became a Roman commercial centre and bishopric. The town lies in the Hoya de Baza beneath Jabalcón; the celebrated Lady of Baza sculpture recalls its Iron Age past.
simp_chinese: 巴萨古称巴斯蒂，由伊比利亚人于公元前4世纪建立，后成为罗马商业中心与主教驻地。城镇坐落于哈瓦尔孔山下的巴萨盆地，著名的巴萨贵妇雕像见证着其铁器时代历史。

english: Bazarny Syzgan lies in the Ulyanovsk country of Russia. It serves as the administrative centre of its surrounding district and is classed as a work settlement. Its population declined between the late Soviet period and the early twenty-first century.
simp_chinese: 巴扎尔内瑟兹甘位于俄罗斯乌里扬诺夫斯克地区，是同名行政区的中心，分类上属于工人镇。苏联晚期至二十一世纪初，当地人口逐渐减少。

english: The Bazaruto islands lie off Vilankulo on Mozambique's Indian Ocean coast. Much of the archipelago was formed from sand deposited by the Save River before that river changed course, while Santa Carolina is a rocky island bordered by deep channels. Scholars have tentatively connected the group with the island called Crocodile in the eleventh-century Egyptian Book of Curiosities. That identification remains uncertain, but the account places a possible early reference within the East African coastal world known to Egyptian merchants.
simp_chinese: 巴扎鲁托群岛位于莫桑比克维兰库洛外海。群岛很大部分由萨韦河改道前沉积的沙形成，圣卡罗来纳岛则为岩岛，周围有深水通道。有学者推测，这里可能就是十一世纪埃及《奇观书》所记的“鳄鱼岛”。这一对应尚不确定，却提示群岛或曾进入埃及商人所知的东非沿岸地理。

english: Bazas crowns a narrow promontory above the Beuve valley southeast of Bordeaux. Known as Cossio in antiquity, it was the centre of the Vasates and one of Roman Novempopulania's twelve cities. An episcopal seat from the early medieval period until 1790, it gave its name to the Bazadais. Its Gothic cathedral, built between the thirteenth and sixteenth centuries, and surviving ramparts preserve the conjunction of ecclesiastical authority and urban defence on this commanding site.
simp_chinese: 巴扎斯高踞波尔多东南伯夫河谷上方的狭长岬地。古称科西奥，曾是瓦萨特人的中心，也是罗马九民行省十二城之一。中世纪早期至1790年，这里长期设主教座，并为巴扎代地区命名。十三至十六世纪修建的哥特式大教堂与残存城垣，将宗教权威和城市防御共同保存在这处高地。

english: Bazer Sakhra lies in northeastern Algeria. It is a town and commune within the Sétif country, forming one of that region's local settlements.
simp_chinese: 巴泽尔萨赫拉位于阿尔及利亚东北部。它是塞提夫地区的一座城镇和市镇，属于当地聚落网络的一部分。

english: Bazhai belongs to Yunnan’s mountain country in southwestern China. In the wider province, heights descend from the northwest toward the southeast, and deeply cut western valleys can lie thousands of metres below nearby summits; its varied terrain supports exceptionally diverse plant life.
simp_chinese: 八寨属于中国西南部云南的山地。广义云南地势从西北向东南降低，西部深切河谷与附近山峰可相差数千米；这种多样地形孕育了格外丰富的植物。

english: Bazhai belongs to the Duyun country of Guizhou. The wider region around the Jian River was drawn into the Miao rising of 1735–36, with the regional centre participating from its early stages before the revolt was forcibly suppressed.
simp_chinese: 八寨属于贵州都匀地区。更广阔的剑江周边区域卷入1735至1736年苗民起事，区域中心从早期便参与其中，随后起事遭强力镇压。

english: Bazin belongs to the northern Ethiopian and Eritrean border country. In the wider region, the kingdom of D’mt extended across northern Ethiopia and Eritrea in antiquity, followed by the long-lived civilization of Aksum.
simp_chinese: 巴津属于埃塞俄比亚北部与厄立特里亚边地。在更广阔的区域，古代达莫特王国横跨埃塞俄比亚北部与厄立特里亚，其后出现延续已久的阿克苏姆文明。

english: Bazman is a dormant stratovolcano in the deserts of southeastern Iran. A crater about 500 metres wide crowns its summit, while smaller volcanic centers dot its flanks.
simp_chinese: 巴兹曼是伊朗东南部荒漠中的一座休眠层火山。其峰顶有直径约500米的火山口，山坡上散布着较小的火山中心。

english: Beagle Gulf opens west into the Timor Sea between Australia's northern mainland and Bathurst and Melville islands. Clarence Strait connects it eastward with Van Diemen Gulf, while Darwin and Bynoe provide natural harbours along its southern shore. Captain John Clements Wickham named the gulf during the Beagle's northern survey of 1837–1838. The familiar ship name can be misleading: Darwin and FitzRoy's earlier voyage did not visit these waters. Its naming belongs to the vessel's later surveying work.
simp_chinese: 比格尔湾位于澳大利亚北部大陆与巴瑟斯特、梅尔维尔两岛之间，向西通帝汶海，东经克拉伦斯海峡连范迪门湾，南岸有达尔文和拜诺天然港湾。约翰·克莱门茨·威克姆船长在1837至1838年的北澳测量中以“比格尔”号命名此湾。熟悉的船名容易造成误解：达尔文和菲茨罗伊此前的航行没有到过这里，命名属于该船较晚的测绘任务。

english: Bealanana stands more than a thousand metres above sea level in northern Madagascar's Sofia country. The town lies south of the Tsaratanana Reserve, in a landscape associated with the Tsimihety people. Its agricultural hinterland is strongly centred on rice, with sugarcane, maize and onions among the other important crops. Livestock raising and fishing add to the range of rural livelihoods. The modern settlement serves these farming communities as a local centre, while its highland position distinguishes it from Madagascar's coastal towns.
simp_chinese: 贝阿拉纳纳坐落在马达加斯加北部的索非亚地区，海拔超过一千米。城镇位于察拉塔纳纳保护区以南，周围是与齐米赫蒂人相联系的地域。这里的农业腹地以稻作为主，甘蔗、玉米和洋葱也是重要作物。畜牧与捕鱼进一步丰富了乡村生计。现代聚落为周边务农社群提供地方中心，而高地位置也使它与马达加斯加的沿海城镇有所区别。

english: Beami is a Papuan language of Papua New Guinea, also called Bedamuni or Mougulu. Its varieties include the Komofio dialect.
simp_chinese: 贝阿米语是巴布亚新几内亚的一种巴布亚语言，也称贝达穆尼语或莫乌古卢语。它的变体包括科莫菲奥方言。

english: Beanka belongs to Madagascar’s distinctive island environment. Long isolation after separation from Africa and India allowed its plants and animals to evolve independently, producing exceptionally high levels of endemic wildlife.
simp_chinese: 贝安卡属于马达加斯加独特的岛屿环境。与非洲和印度分离后的长期隔绝，使当地动植物独立演化，形成极高比例的特有野生物种。

english: Bear Island lies between Spitsbergen and Norway’s North Cape, at the boundary of the Norwegian and Barents seas. Dutch explorers reached it in 1596 and named it after a polar bear seen swimming nearby.
simp_chinese: 熊岛位于斯匹次卑尔根岛与挪威北角之间，处在挪威海和巴伦支海交界。荷兰探险者于1596年抵达，以附近游泳的一头北极熊为它命名。

english: The Bear Islands are black basalt outcrops in James Bay southeast of the Belcher Islands. Bear Island and the Two Cubs Islands form this small uninhabited group, with Sunday Island nearby.
simp_chinese: 熊岛群是詹姆斯湾中、贝尔彻群岛东南的一组黑色玄武岩露头。熊岛与两只幼熊岛构成这组无人小岛，附近还有星期日岛。

english: The Bear River country belongs to the Great Basin of western North America. Across that broad interior, rivers drain into enclosed basins rather than reaching the ocean, amid an arid landscape of ranges and valleys.
simp_chinese: 熊河地区属于北美西部的大盆地。在这片广阔内陆，河流汇入封闭盆地而不通海，周围是山岭与谷地相间的干旱景观。

english: The western Bear River country belongs to the Great Basin. The river is the basin’s longest, running through a region of inward-draining watersheds whose lakes and valleys have no outlet to the ocean.
simp_chinese: 西熊河地区属于大盆地。贝尔河是盆地最长河流，流经湖泊与河谷无海洋出口的内流水系区域。

english: The Beatton country lies in the boreal forests and muskeg of the Peace Plain. Its river rises at Pink Mountain and reaches the Peace near Fort St. John, within the traditional homeland of the Dane-zaa.
simp_chinese: 比顿地区位于皮斯平原的北方针叶林与泥炭沼泽中。同名河流发源于粉红山，在圣约翰堡附近汇入皮斯河，属于达内扎人的传统故土。

english: Beaugency stands on the Loire between Orléans and Blois. Its lords rose to prominence during the eleventh to thirteenth centuries, replacing a wooden castle with a stone stronghold whose great keep survives as a shell. They sold the lordship to the crown late in the thirteenth century. The town also supported a tradition of Jewish learning: Aaron ben Joseph and Eliezer of Beaugency worked here as biblical commentators in the twelfth century. Fortified power and scholarship occupied the same river town.
simp_chinese: 博让西位于奥尔良与布卢瓦之间的卢瓦尔河畔。地方领主在十一至十三世纪兴盛，将木堡改筑为石质要塞，巨大的主塔外壳仍存，十三世纪末又把领地出售给王室。城内也有犹太学术传统：十二世纪的亚伦·本·约瑟夫和埃利泽都在此从事《圣经》注释。设防领主权力与经学研究，在同一座河城留下了各自痕迹。

english: Beaujeu gave its name to the Beaujolais region during the tenth century. The wider country north of Lyon has a long wine-growing tradition, with Roman vineyards followed by Benedictine cultivation through the Middle Ages.
simp_chinese: 博热在10世纪将其名称赋予博若莱地区。更广阔的里昂以北区域拥有悠久葡萄种植传统，罗马葡萄园之后，中世纪本笃会修士继续从事栽培。

english: Beaumont au Maine stands on the Sarthe River, roughly midway between Alençon and Le Mans. Before the French Revolution it was known as Beaumont-le-Vicomte. Its riverside setting places it within the historic province of Maine.
simp_chinese: 曼恩地区博蒙位于萨尔特河畔，大致处于阿朗松与勒芒之间。法国大革命以前，它被称为Beaumont-le-Vicomte。这座河畔城镇属于历史上的曼恩省。

english: Beaune stands below Burgundy's Côte d'Or hills, surrounded by vineyards and linked closely to the dukes of Burgundy. Wine cellars and merchants occupy a town whose history reaches back through Roman and pre-Roman times. Much of its walls, moat and battlements survives, enclosing a substantial old centre. The fifteenth-century Hospices de Beaune adds another distinctive feature, with the coloured roof tiles characteristic of the region. Its wine auction joins charitable foundations and commerce in one of Burgundy's best-known urban traditions.
simp_chinese: 博讷位于勃艮第金丘山麓，葡萄园环绕，与勃艮第公爵关系密切。酒窖和酒商聚集于历史可追溯至罗马及更早时期的城中，城墙、壕沟和垛口仍大部保存，围合着广阔古城区。十五世纪博讷济贫院以本地区特色彩色屋瓦增添鲜明地标，其葡萄酒拍卖又将慈善机构与商业结合，成为勃艮第著名城市传统。

english: Beaupréau lies in the Mauges country of western Anjou, crossed by the river Èvre. The settlement was already a town of 2,678 inhabitants in 1793, during the French Revolution. Its recorded population fell to 1,640 by 1800 before recovering to more than three thousand in the 1830s. These figures preserve the changing scale of this small Angevin community beside its river, long before its later incorporation into the larger commune of Beaupréau-en-Mauges.
simp_chinese: 博普雷欧位于安茹西部的莫日地区，埃夫尔河流经其间。法国大革命期间，1793年的这里已是一座拥有二千六百七十八名居民的城镇。登记人口到1800年降至一千六百四十人，随后在十九世纪三十年代恢复到三千余人。这些数字保留了这处安茹河畔小社群规模变化的记录；它并入更大的博普雷欧昂莫日市镇，则是很久以后的事。

english: Beautemps-Beaupré Atoll belongs to the wider New Caledonian island world in the southwest Pacific. This Melanesian archipelago includes Grande Terre, the Loyalty Islands and numerous smaller offshore islands.
simp_chinese: 博当·博普雷环礁属于西南太平洋更广阔的新喀里多尼亚群岛地区。这片美拉尼西亚群岛包括大地岛、洛亚蒂群岛及众多较小的离岛。

english: Beauvais lies north of Paris and long held an important episcopal identity. Its medieval bishop participated in French coronation ritual, while the town itself repeatedly faced war. It resisted English attacks in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries and endured a Burgundian siege in 1472. The defence became especially associated with Jeanne Hachette and the women of the town. Their remembered actions were honoured by an annual procession in which women took precedence, giving civic ritual a distinctive account of collective defence.
simp_chinese: 博韦位于巴黎以北，长期以主教城身份著称，主教参与法国加冕仪式，城镇本身则屡遭战争。十四、十五世纪它抵御英军，1472年又遭勃艮第围攻。守城记忆尤其与让娜·阿谢特及城中妇女相连，后来的年度游行让女性优先行进，以独特市民仪式纪念共同防御的经历。

english: Beauvoir belongs to Poitou in west-central France. The wider province had its historic capital at Poitiers, and both names preserve the memory of the ancient Pictones people.
simp_chinese: 博瓦尔属于法国中西部的普瓦图。更广阔的省份以普瓦捷为历史首府，两地名称都保留着古代皮克通人的印记。

english: Beaver is a small settlement in Alaska’s Yukon–Koyukuk region, known in Koyukon as Ts’aahudaaneekk’onh Denh. It first appeared in the United States census as an unincorporated village in 1930 and remained a predominantly Native community in the 2020 census.
simp_chinese: 比弗是阿拉斯加育空—科尤库克地区的一处小聚落，科尤孔语名为Ts’aahudaaneekk’onh Denh。1930年它首次作为未建制村落见于美国人口普查，2020年普查时仍以原住民人口为主。

english: Beaver Cove opens beside northern Vancouver Island at the mouth of the Kokish River. The inlet later became associated with logging and the Englewood Railway, whose terminus linked the forest interior with this sheltered coastal landing.
simp_chinese: 比弗湾位于温哥华岛北部、科基什河河口。海湾后来与伐木业和恩格尔伍德铁路相联系，铁路终点将森林内陆与这处避风的沿海停靠地相连。

english: These forests belong to the traditional country of the Dane-zaa around the Peace River. The Athabaskan-speaking people were historically called Beaver by Europeans, while their homeland extends across parts of Alberta and British Columbia.
simp_chinese: 这片森林属于和平河周边达内扎人的传统家园。这个使用阿萨巴斯卡语的族群历史上被欧洲人称为海狸人，故土横跨艾伯塔与不列颠哥伦比亚部分地区。

english: The Beaver Plains belong to the traditional country of the Dane-zaa around the Peace River. Known to Europeans as Beaver people, these Athabaskan-speaking communities also once occupied lands near the Athabasca and Clearwater rivers.
simp_chinese: 河狸平原属于和平河周围达内扎人的传统地域。欧洲人称其为河狸人，这些阿萨巴斯卡语社群过去还曾居住在阿萨巴斯卡河与克利尔沃特河附近。

english: The Beaverhead country lies against the Continental Divide in the northern Rocky Mountains, where much of the later Montana-Idaho boundary follows the high watershed. The Big Hole River, once called the Wisdom, runs through this mountain region. Its name preserves a Shoshone description of a rock formation resembling a beaver's head. Later gold seekers founded Bannack, the first county seat, before administration shifted to Dillon. The modern boundaries are recent, but the older landmark recalls an Indigenous way of reading the shape of the land.
simp_chinese: 比弗黑德地区依傍落基山脉北部的大陆分水岭，后来蒙大拿与爱达荷之间的大段边界沿着高地分水线展开。曾称智慧河的大洞河流经这片山地。地区名称保存了肖肖尼人对一处岩石的描述：它的形状宛如河狸头。后来淘金者建立班纳克，作为最早的县治，行政中心又迁至狄龙。现代边界虽然年轻，古老地标却让人看见原住民如何从地貌形状中认识土地。

english: Bebaramau Jungle belongs to the Darién borderland between Colombia and Panama. In the wider region, dense rainforest, mountain ridges and the marshy Atrato drainage form a formidable natural barrier. This same difficult country is the land bridge between North and South America, traversed by people and wildlife over long periods.
simp_chinese: 贝巴拉毛丛林属于哥伦比亚与巴拿马之间的达连边地。在更广阔地区，茂密雨林、山岭与沼泽化的阿特拉托河流域形成难以穿越的天然屏障。这片艰险土地同时也是南北美洲之间的陆桥，人类与野生动物长期由此迁徙。

english: Bebedero Salt Pan lies within the wider eastern lands known to the Mapuche as Puelmapu. This traditional territory extended across much of the Pampas and Patagonia east of the Andes. Argentina incorporated the region through the nineteenth-century campaigns called the Conquest of the Desert.
simp_chinese: 贝贝德罗盐沼位于马普切人称为普埃尔马普的更广阔东方土地之内。这片传统领地延伸于安第斯山以东的大片潘帕草原与巴塔哥尼亚。十九世纪被称为“征服荒漠”的军事行动使该地区被纳入阿根廷。

english: Becaguimec belongs to the wider New Brunswick country of Atlantic Canada. This heavily forested region has snowy winters and temperate summers, with Appalachian uplands occupying its northern half.
simp_chinese: 贝卡吉梅克属于加拿大大西洋沿岸更广阔的新不伦瑞克地区。这里森林密布，冬季多雪、夏季温和，北半部为阿巴拉契亚高地。

english: Béchar lies beside its namesake wadi in northwestern Algeria, where palm groves and irrigated plots contrast with the dry surrounding country. Its old ksar and fort preserve an earlier built landscape, while leatherwork and jewellery remain notable crafts. The town later became a French Foreign Legion post and prospered through nearby coal mining before petroleum reduced that industry's importance. Dates, figs, cereals and almonds link its economy to the careful use of water as well as to underground resources.
simp_chinese: 贝沙尔位于阿尔及利亚西北部同名干河旁，棕榈园与灌溉田地同周围干旱环境形成对照。旧克萨尔聚落和堡垒保留较早建筑景观，皮革与首饰是特色工艺。后来这里成为法国外籍军团驻地，并因煤矿繁荣，石油兴起后煤业地位下降。椰枣、无花果、谷物和杏，则显示经济也依赖水源管理，而不限于地下资源。

english: Becharof Lake stretches through the Aleutian Range on the Alaska Peninsula southeast of Egegik. It is Alaska's second-largest lake after Iliamna. Russian hydrographic records used the name Ozero Ugashek on an 1852 chart. After the United States acquired Alaska in 1867, naturalist William Healey Dall named the lake in 1868. Its recorded names therefore belong to successive phases of exploration and mapping, laid over a much older lake landscape in the mountainous peninsula.
simp_chinese: 贝沙罗夫湖横卧阿拉斯加半岛阿留申山脉、埃盖吉克东南，是阿拉斯加仅次于伊利亚姆纳湖的第二大湖。俄国水文部门1852年海图称其为乌加舍克湖。1867年美国购得阿拉斯加后，博物学家威廉·希利·多尔于1868年为湖命名。地图名称记录了连续的探索与测绘阶段，覆盖在半岛更为古老的山地湖泊景观之上。

english: Bechyně stands where the Lužnice and Smutná meet in southern Bohemia. A Slavic fortified settlement preceded the stone castle commissioned after Ottokar II acquired the site in 1268. King John promoted the castle village to a town in 1323. Hussite forces burned it in the following century, but later Renaissance rebuilding under Peter Vok of Rosenberg renewed its appearance. Pottery making developed from the sixteenth century, and a healing spring recorded in 1576 added a spa tradition to the river town.
simp_chinese: 贝希涅位于南波希米亚卢日尼采河与斯穆特纳河汇合处。早期斯拉夫设防聚落之后，奥托卡二世1268年取得此地并命筑石堡，约翰国王1323年将堡下村落升为城镇。下个世纪胡斯军焚城，后来彼得·沃克时期的文艺复兴改建重塑面貌。十六世纪起陶业发展，1576年记载的疗养泉又为河城增添温泉传统。

english: Bedale lies beside a tributary of the Swale in Yorkshire's agricultural country. Its name recalls Beda's corner of land, and Domesday Book records the settlement and its early church. The Bedale Hoard offers material evidence of Anglo-Saxon and Viking-age activity. After the Norman conquest the manor passed through the Breton connections of Richmond, while a later castle stood on the site of Bedale Hall. Market life developed within this landscape of church, manor and fertile dale, linking local farming to wider exchange.
simp_chinese: 贝代尔位于约克郡农业地带、斯韦尔河支流旁，地名意为“贝达的一角土地”。《末日审判书》记载聚落及早期教堂，贝代尔窖藏则提供盎格鲁撒克逊和维京时代活动的实物证据。诺曼征服后庄园通过里士满的布列塔尼关系转手，后来的城堡位于贝代尔府邸旧址。集市在教堂、庄园与肥沃谷地之间发展，将本地农业接入更大交换网络。

english: Beden lies in the Rhodope mountain country of southern Bulgaria. The wider range is noted for karst landscapes, deep river gorges and large caves, with its southern slopes extending into Greece.
simp_chinese: 贝登位于保加利亚南部的罗多彼山区。更广的山脉以喀斯特地貌、深切河谷和大洞穴著称，南坡延伸入希腊。

english: Bedford grew at a ford over the Great Ouse, becoming a market centre for the surrounding farms. In 886 it marked the boundary between Wessex and the Danelaw. Its castle was destroyed in 1224, but the borough charter of 1166 helped sustain urban institutions. Lace making became important from the sixteenth century, and river navigation reached the town in 1689. The crossing that gave Bedford its location thus developed into a place of markets, craft production and communication within the English interior.
simp_chinese: 贝德福德兴起于大乌斯河渡口，成为周围农地的集市中心。886年它处在威塞克斯与丹麦法区边界。城堡1224年被毁，1166年的自治市特许则帮助城市制度延续。十六世纪起花边制作兴盛，1689年河流通航延伸至此。渡口由此发展为英格兰内陆兼具集市、手工生产与交通的城镇。

english: Bedia belongs to the wider historical country of Mingrelia in western Georgia. Mingrelia was formerly known as Odishi, and its humid Black Sea environment includes extensive marshland and distinctive wildlife.
simp_chinese: 贝迪亚位于格鲁吉亚西部广义的明格列利亚历史区域。明格列利亚旧称奥迪希，其湿润的黑海环境包括大片沼泽及独特的野生动物。

english: Bednur, later called Nagara, was the last capital of the Keladi Nayakas in the forested country of Karnataka. Its fort occupied a low hill beside a lake, with a system for carrying water around the defenses. Palace remains, the royal audience hall and paired tanks preserve the character of a fortified court. Hyder Ali captured it in 1763 and renamed it Hydernagar. British occupation in 1783 was brief before Tipu Sultan recovered the place. A farmers’ revolt in 1830 added another chapter to the struggles over a town whose name in Kannada simply means city.
simp_chinese: 贝德努尔后来称纳加拉，是卡纳塔克林地中凯拉迪纳亚克诸王最后的首都。堡垒占据湖边低丘，并设有将水引绕防御工事的系统。宫殿遗迹、王室朝会厅与成对水池，保存着设防宫廷的面貌。海德尔·阿里于1763年攻取此地，改称海德尔纳加尔。1783年的英国占领十分短暂，蒂普苏丹随即收复。1830年农民起义又为这座城市增添一章；它的卡纳达语名称纳加拉，意思就是“城市”。

english: Beer Dun belongs to Cayor in the Senegalese country west of Jolof. The wider kingdom emerged as an independent power in 1549 and grew into the strongest of the states that broke away from the Jolof Empire.
simp_chinese: 比尔敦属于若洛夫以西塞内加尔地区的卡约尔。更广阔的王国于1549年成为独立势力，并发展为脱离若洛夫帝国诸国中最强的一支。

english: Beersheba belongs to the Negev's well country. The ancient town at Tel Be'er Sheva lies several kilometres from the modern city and preserves an Iron Age street plan and elaborate water system. Under Byzantine rule the area formed a key point on the Limes Palestinae before coming under Arab and later Ottoman authority. For centuries it remained a watering and trading place for Bedouin groups. The distinction between ancient tell and modern settlement matters here: both depend on a landscape where access to water shapes movement and habitation.
simp_chinese: 贝尔谢巴位于内盖夫井水地带。古城丘距现代城市数公里，保存铁器时代街道布局与复杂供水系统。拜占庭时期，这里是巴勒斯坦边防线要点，后来先后受阿拉伯和奥斯曼统治。数百年间，它也是贝都因人的饮水与交易地点。古城丘和现代聚落应加区分，但两者都处在由水源决定通行与居住的环境。

english: Beeskow stands on the Spree southwest of Frankfurt an der Oder. The bishopric of Lubusz purchased it in 1518, and its last bishop died here in 1555. Despite later regional changes, the town remained formally a Bohemian fief until Prussia annexed it in 1742. In the nineteenth century it lay on an escape route used by Polish insurgents after the failed November Uprising. Its river location thus accompanied a history crossing ecclesiastical jurisdictions, royal claims and the movement of political exiles.
simp_chinese: 贝斯科位于法兰克福西南的施普雷河畔。卢布什主教区1518年购得此城，末任主教1555年死于此。虽然地区政局变化，城镇在形式上仍为波希米亚封地，直到1742年被普鲁士吞并。十九世纪波兰十一月起义失败后，逃亡者经过此地。滨河位置由此伴随跨越教会辖区、王室主张与政治流亡的历史。

english: Beesowuunenno lies in the High Plains east of the Rocky Mountains. The wider Great Plains form the western part of North America’s Interior Plains, with extensive prairie, steppe and grassland. This open country extends north into Canada and south across much of the central United States.
simp_chinese: 贝索乌内诺位于落基山以东的高地平原。更广阔的大平原构成北美内陆平原的西部，广布草原、干草原和草地。这片开阔地带向北伸入加拿大，向南横跨美国中部大片地区。

english: Befandriana belongs to the wider Tsimihety country of north-central Madagascar. The people’s name means those who never cut their hair, a tradition associated with independence from the Sakalava rulers to the west.
simp_chinese: 贝凡德里亚纳属于马达加斯加中北部更广阔的齐米赫蒂地区。族名意为从不剪发的人，这一传统与独立于西部萨卡拉瓦统治者有关。

english: Begho stood near the meeting of forest and savanna in the Bono lands, where gold from the Akan country could enter the trading networks of the Niger and Sahara. Known also as Nsoko, the settlement grew into a cosmopolitan market with local Brong communities and Mande-speaking Muslim merchants. By the fifteenth century its commercial quarters connected southern goldfields with Jenne and Timbuktu, while routes led onward to the Atlantic coast. Its prosperity rested on craft as well as exchange: excavations reveal spindle whorls, dye pits, ironworking debris and brass crucibles. Courtyard houses and separate artisan districts suggest a sprawling town rather than a single monumental center. Traditions associate its decline with eighteenth-century conflict and dispersal, and communities elsewhere remembered Begho as an ancestral home. Pottery, metalworking and textiles preserve the traces of a city whose influence extended far beyond its ruins.
simp_chinese: 贝戈位于博诺地区森林与稀树草原的交界，阿肯金矿的黄金由此进入尼日尔河流域与撒哈拉商路。这座又称恩索科的市镇吸引了本地布朗居民和使用曼德语的穆斯林商人。十五世纪时，其商业街区已把南方金矿同杰内、廷巴克图连接起来，另有道路通往大西洋海岸。繁荣也来自手工业：考古发现纺轮、染坑、铁渣和熔炼黄铜的坩埚，庭院住宅与工匠聚落共同组成分散而广阔的城市。地方传统把衰落与十八世纪冲突和人口离散相联系，别处的社群仍将此地视为祖居。陶器、纺织与金属加工留下的遗物，记录了这座商贸城市超出自身疆界的影响。

english: Begoml first appears in written records in 1582 as a village on an estate belonging to the bishop of Vilnius at Vaucha. It then lay in the Minsk district of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, placing this small settlement within the landed possessions of a distant ecclesiastical lord. Its later development was gradual: by 1861 it had become a volost centre, and in 1886 it still comprised only forty-three households, together with a church, school and hospital. A distillery was established in the 1870s. The modern township thus grew from a modest village whose documented history began under Lithuanian rule.
simp_chinese: 别戈姆利最早见于1582年的文字记录，当时是一座村庄，位于维尔纽斯主教在沃恰拥有的庄园之中。这里隶属立陶宛大公国的明斯克地区，小小聚落因此成为远方教会领主的地产。其后发展颇为缓慢：到1861年，它已成为乡级行政中心；1886年仍只有四十三户人家，以及一座教堂、一所学校和一所医院。当地另于十九世纪七十年代建立了酿酒厂。后来的城镇由这座朴素村庄逐渐成长，其可考历史始于立陶宛统治时期。

english: Behabad is a town in Iran’s Yazd region. It became the centre of a separate county after the former district was detached from Bafq in the early twenty-first century.
simp_chinese: 贝哈巴德是伊朗亚兹德地区的城镇。二十一世纪初，原辖区从巴夫格分出设县，这里成为新县的行政中心。

english: Behali, also called Bahali, occupies a mountain-ringed valley in Hazara, near the boundary between Mansehra and Abbottabad. The settlement lies west of Qalanderabad and the route now followed by the Karakoram Highway. It is one of a group of villages including Matehal, Rehar, Karer and Ogra that fall within the later union council. Turks of Behali, Tanolis, Awans and Rajas are among the communities associated with the valley, giving this small place a varied social landscape.
simp_chinese: 贝哈里亦称巴哈里，位于哈扎拉一处群山环抱的谷地，靠近曼塞赫拉与阿伯塔巴德的交界。聚落位于卡兰达拉巴德以西，也在今日喀喇昆仑公路所经路线的西侧。后来设立的乡级行政区还包括马特哈尔、雷哈尔、卡雷尔和奥格拉等村落。贝哈里的突厥人、塔诺利人、阿万人和拉贾等社群与这片谷地相联系，为这处小地方构成了多样的社会面貌。

english: Behbahan lies in Iran’s Khuzestan region near the ancient city of Arrajan. Its surrounding country was known for gardens and agricultural production, including dates and citrus fruit.
simp_chinese: 贝赫巴汉位于伊朗胡齐斯坦地区，靠近古城阿拉詹。周围地区以园圃和农业生产著称，出产椰枣及柑橘等。

english: Beichlingen lies on the southern edge of the Schmuecke above the Thuringian Basin, close to Koelleda. Its recorded history reaches back to 1014, and the settlement became associated with the comital house that bore its name. The castle and the landed families connected with it gave this small village a place in the political landscape of central Germany. Later the Werthern-Beichlingen family continued the link between residence, manor and surrounding countryside. Its significance is therefore best understood at a local scale: a noble seat surrounded by agricultural communities, rather than a great market city. The survival of the village beside its aristocratic estate illustrates how lordship was anchored in particular places and family names, even where the settlement itself remained modest.
simp_chinese: 拜希林根坐落在施米克丘陵南缘、图林根盆地附近，邻近克勒达。其文字记载可追溯至1014年，村落后来与同名伯爵家族紧密相连。城堡和拥有周边土地的贵族，使这处小聚落进入德意志中部的政治版图；此后韦尔特恩—拜希林根家族又延续了宅邸、庄园和乡村之间的联系。这里的重要性主要体现在地方层面：它是一座由农业村落环绕的贵族驻地，城市规模并不宏大。聚落与领主庄园并存的格局，说明家族名称、地产和统治权如何在一个具体地点长期结合。

english: Beihai was a historic commandery in northern Shandong. Founded under Emperor Jing of Han, it expanded through changes in neighbouring royal territories and later became a kingdom under the Eastern Han.
simp_chinese: 北海是山东北部的历史郡名。汉景帝时设立，随着邻近诸侯领地调整而扩展，东汉又曾改为王国。

english: Beiliu lies in southeastern Guangxi under Yulin’s administration. The city is home to Guangxi Sanhuan, a major ceramics manufacturer.
simp_chinese: 北流位于广西东南部，隶属玉林。大型陶瓷制造企业广西三环的总部设在这里。

english: Beilngries lies on the Altmühl in the Franconian Jura country of Bavaria. The town stands north of Ingolstadt, and in the modern period the Rhine-Main-Danube Canal added another waterway beside its river setting.
simp_chinese: 拜尔恩格里斯位于巴伐利亚法兰克尼亚侏罗山区的阿尔特米尔河畔。城镇在因戈尔施塔特以北，近现代莱茵—美因—多瑙运河又为这里增添了一条水道。

english: The Beira estuary belongs to Mozambique’s Indian Ocean coast. Across this wider coastline, Swahili port towns developed between the seventh and eleventh centuries and later drew merchants from Arabia, Persia, India and northeastern Africa.
simp_chinese: 贝拉河口属于莫桑比克的印度洋海岸。在这片广大沿岸，七至十一世纪出现了斯瓦希里港镇，后来吸引阿拉伯、波斯、印度与非洲东北部商人来访。

english: Beirut occupies a coastal site where settlement layers record the passage of Phoenician, Hellenistic, Roman, Byzantine, Arab, Crusader and Ottoman powers. Its name is traced to a Phoenician word for wells, an appropriate reminder that accessible water helped sustain the port. Biruta appears in the fourteenth-century BCE Amarna correspondence, placing it within the diplomatic world of the eastern Mediterranean long before classical antiquity. In 140 BCE the city was destroyed during a Seleucid dynastic struggle and rebuilt as Laodicea in Phoenicia. Greek Berytos became Latin Berytus, and its Roman colonial title advertised imperial patronage. Later inhabitants built upon the same confined landscape, leaving successive cities buried beneath their streets. The port's interest lies in that accumulation: a meeting place of sea routes, local water supplies and the changing political orders of the Levant.
simp_chinese: 贝鲁特占据黎凡特沿海一处古老聚居点，其地下层层叠压着腓尼基、希腊化、罗马、拜占庭、阿拉伯、十字军与奥斯曼时代的遗迹。地名被认为源自腓尼基语“井”，反映了可取得的水源对于港口生活的重要性。公元前十四世纪的阿马尔奈书信已经提到比鲁塔，使它很早就进入东地中海的外交网络。公元前140年，城市在塞琉古王朝争位中遭到摧毁，重建后曾称腓尼基的劳迪基亚；希腊名贝里托斯后来又成为拉丁名贝里图斯，罗马殖民城市的正式称号则彰显皇室庇护。后来的居民不断在同一有限空间营建，留下海路、水源和政治权力反复交汇的城市地层。

english: Beishe belongs to the broad Sichuan country of southwestern China. The region embraces the Sichuan Basin and highlands toward Tibet, between the Jinsha River and the Daba Mountains.
simp_chinese: 北社属于中国西南部广阔的四川地区。这里包括四川盆地及通往西藏的高地，处在金沙江与大巴山之间。

english: Beisheng belongs to the Yongsheng country of northwestern Yunnan. The wider district contains Chenghai Lake and a diverse population including Yi, Lisu and Naxi communities, while its agricultural lands produce pomegranates, citrus and other fruits.
simp_chinese: 北胜属于云南西北部的永胜地区。范围更大的永胜拥有程海，以及彝族、傈僳族、纳西族等多样社群，农地出产石榴、柑橘与其他水果。

english: Beius lies on the Crisul Negru beneath the Apuseni Mountains, at a passage between the agricultural country of Bihar and the uplands of western Transylvania. Its first recorded mention, in 1263, recalled destruction during the Mongol invasion of 1241. The settlement subsequently passed through Ottoman rule before Habsburg conquest in 1691, a change confirmed by the Treaty of Karlowitz. These changes placed a small river town within much larger struggles over the Carpathian frontier. From the late eighteenth century Beius also became an important center of Romanian-language learning in Crisana; the school founded by Samuil Vulcan in 1828 gave that role an enduring institutional form. Nearby limestone mountains contain extensive caves and mineral resources, while the town's collections preserve the tools, clothing and pottery of its rural hinterland.
simp_chinese: 贝尤什位于黑克里什河畔、阿普塞尼山地脚下，连接比豪尔农耕地区与特兰西瓦尼亚西部高地。1263年的早期文献提及此地时，追述了1241年蒙古入侵造成的破坏。聚落后来经历奥斯曼统治，1691年又被哈布斯堡军队夺取，这一变化得到卡尔洛夫奇条约确认。小小河镇因此置身于争夺喀尔巴阡边疆的大规模政治斗争之中。十八世纪末以后，它还成为克里沙纳地区罗马尼亚语教育的重要中心，1828年设立的萨穆伊尔·武尔坎学校使这一传统获得长期依托。周围石灰岩山地拥有洞穴与矿产，地方收藏的农具、服饰和陶器则展现了市镇与乡村腹地的联系。

english: Beja belongs to southern Portugal on the Iberian Peninsula. In the wider peninsula’s history, Roman armies first arrived in 218 BCE during the Second Punic War, beginning a long transformation of the lands they called Hispania.
simp_chinese: 贝雅属于伊比利亚半岛上的葡萄牙南部。从整个半岛的历史看，罗马军队于公元前218年第二次布匿战争期间首次到来，开始长期改变他们称作西班牙行省的这片土地。

english: Beja belongs to the Medjerda country of northern Tunisia. The wider river rises in the Tell Atlas and flows toward the Gulf of Tunis, supplying water to wheat-growing lands and drawing successive Carthaginian, Roman and later powers.
simp_chinese: 贝贾属于突尼斯北部迈杰尔达地区。大河发源于泰勒阿特拉斯山，流向突尼斯湾，为麦作土地供水，并吸引迦太基、罗马及后来的各方势力。

english: The Beja coast faces the Red Sea across from Arabia. Shallow shelves and coral communities fringe a narrow oceanic inlet connected southwards to the Gulf of Aden and Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese: 贝贾海岸隔红海与阿拉伯相望。浅海陆架与珊瑚群落环绕狭长海域，向南连接亚丁湾和印度洋。

english: Bejaâd lies in central Morocco’s Khouribga country. Also known as Boujaad, it is regarded as the capital of the Beni Zemmour tribe.
simp_chinese: 贝贾阿德位于摩洛哥中部的胡里卜盖地区，也称布贾阿德。这里被视为贝尼宰穆尔部落的中心。

english: Bejaia looks out over a sheltered Mediterranean bay beneath Mount Gouraya, with Cape Carbon protecting its anchorage from offshore weather. The Soummam valley provides a corridor into the interior, although steep mountains and gorges complicate access to the port. Ancient Saldae was a Roman colony, supplied by hydraulic works including the Toudja aqueduct; later rulers reused parts of this inherited water system. Its medieval names Bugia and Bougie traveled with commerce across the Mediterranean. Beeswax exported from the city became so closely associated with its European name that the French word bougie came to mean a candle. Here a port's commercial reputation entered everyday language. Successive North African dynasties and Mediterranean powers valued the same combination of defended bay, water supply and routes through Kabylia, making the city a durable point of contact between mountain country and the sea.
simp_chinese: 贝贾亚背靠古拉亚山，面向一处受卡尔邦角保护的地中海海湾。苏马姆河谷通向内陆，但陡峭山岭与峡谷也使港口同腹地的联系受到限制。古代的萨尔代曾是罗马殖民城市，图德贾引水渠等水利设施为其供水，后世统治者又利用了部分旧有系统。中世纪的布吉亚、布日等名称随着商人传遍地中海；城市出口的大量蜂蜡甚至使法语地名逐渐变成“蜡烛”的通称。一个港口的货物，就这样进入欧洲的日常语言。北非各王朝与跨海势力先后重视这里的避风海湾、水源和穿越卡比利亚的道路，使它长期成为山地社会同海上世界交往的节点。

english: Bejar stands in the country of Salamanca, where surviving walls and religious buildings preserve the outlines of a fortified Castilian settlement. Its name is thought to be older than Roman rule and appears in forms such as Biclara and Biclaro, although its earliest derivation remains uncertain. The church of Santiago belongs to the twelfth century, while Santa Maria la Mayor accumulated features from the medieval period into the seventeenth century, combining Mudejar and later Baroque elements. A fortress was transformed into a residence for the dukes of Bejar during the sixteenth century, giving military architecture a new aristocratic use. The town's Jewish past forms another strand of its history. These walls, churches and palace make the settlement legible through buildings: successive communities altered an inherited defensive landscape rather than replacing it all at once.
simp_chinese: 贝哈尔位于萨拉曼卡地区，保存的城墙和宗教建筑仍能勾勒出卡斯蒂利亚设防聚落的轮廓。地名可能早于罗马统治，曾以比克拉拉、比克拉罗等形式出现，其更早词源尚不确定。圣地亚哥教堂始建于十二世纪，圣母大教堂则从中世纪延续营建至十七世纪，兼有穆德哈尔和后来的巴洛克风格。十六世纪，一处古老堡垒被改造成贝哈尔公爵的宫邸，让防御建筑获得贵族居住的新用途。城镇的犹太历史也是地方记忆的一部分。城墙、教堂与宫殿共同展示了不同社群如何逐层改变原有空间，而非一次性重建整座城市。

english: The Bejar Mountains belong to the wider Iberian highland world. Much of the peninsula is occupied by the Meseta Central, a plateau ringed by mountains through whose gaps the major rivers escape.
simp_chinese: 贝哈尔山脉属于伊比利亚的高地地域。半岛大部分由中央梅塞塔高原占据，周围环绕山地，主要河流穿越山间缺口向外流去。

english: Bekarlar belongs to the Niğde country of Cappadocia. The wider region lies near ancient roads connecting Kayseri with the Cilician Gates and Mediterranean coast, a corridor used by successive Hittite, Roman, Byzantine and Turkish societies.
simp_chinese: 贝卡尔拉尔属于卡帕多西亚尼代地区。更广阔的区域靠近连接开塞利、奇里乞亚关隘与地中海岸的古道，赫梯、罗马、拜占庭和突厥社会相继利用这条走廊。

english: Bekes grew beside the Koros waterways on fertile lowland soils. After the Magyar settlement of the region, the surrounding estates belonged to the Csolt clan, and a castle gave its name to both the town and its county. Thirteenth-century documents identify Bekes as a county seat, but after the Marothi family acquired the district in 1403 its central role gradually shifted toward Gyula. Ottoman conquest brought another transformation: a defensive mound castle was erected and then destroyed during the fighting of 1595, and the area became deserted. Recovery followed the end of Ottoman rule, but warfare under Rakoczi again disrupted settlement. In 1720 Harruckern received the county and encouraged renewed habitation through privileges. Floods remained a recurring constraint on this productive country, linking local prosperity to the management of rivers as closely as to the fortunes of its lords.
simp_chinese: 贝凯什兴起于克勒什水系附近肥沃的低地。马扎尔人进入这一地区后，周边土地属于乔尔特氏族，一座城堡又把名称传给城镇及其所在州。十三世纪文献仍把这里记为州治，但马罗蒂家族于1403年取得当地产业后，区域中心逐渐转向久洛。奥斯曼征服带来新的防御设施；城中的土丘堡垒在1595年战事中被毁，周边一度荒废。奥斯曼统治结束后人口开始恢复，拉科齐战争又造成破坏。1720年，哈鲁克恩获授该州，并以特权鼓励居民重新定居。洪水始终是低地生活的难题，使地方繁荣既取决于领主与战争，也取决于对河流的应对。

english: Beket Ata lies in Mangystau, the arid country east of the Caspian Sea. The wider region includes the Mangyshlak Peninsula and much of Kazakhstan’s Caspian coast, with the Ustyurt plateau, lowlands, isolated ridges and desert depressions forming a strikingly varied landscape.
simp_chinese: 别克特阿塔位于里海以东干旱的曼吉斯套。较广的地区包含曼格什拉克半岛及哈萨克斯坦大段里海海岸，乌斯秋尔特高原、低地、孤立山岭与沙漠洼地构成变化鲜明的景观。

english: Beki belongs to the Mangystau country beside the Caspian Sea. The wider region includes the Mangyshlak Peninsula and much of Kazakhstan’s Caspian shoreline. Deserts, plateaus, mountain ridges and deep depressions form its varied landscape.
simp_chinese: 别乞属于里海沿岸曼吉斯套地区。广义大区包含曼格什拉克半岛和哈萨克斯坦大片里海岸线。荒漠、高原、山岭与深陷洼地构成多样景观。

english: Bela belongs to Balochistan at the southeastern edge of the Iranian plateau. The wider region is a dry landscape of mountains and deserts extending toward the Arabian Sea coast.
simp_chinese: 贝拉属于伊朗高原东南缘的俾路支斯坦。更广区域是由山地与沙漠组成的干旱景观，延伸向阿拉伯海岸。

english: Belabo belongs to the wider Mymensingh country of Bengal. The regional centre stands on the Brahmaputra north of Dhaka. The British East India Company formed the Mymensingh district in 1787, later moving its headquarters after floods devastated the original site at Begunbari.
simp_chinese: 贝拉博属于孟加拉迈门辛的广大地域。区域中心位于达卡以北的布拉马普特拉河畔。英国东印度公司于1787年设立迈门辛区，洪水毁坏原驻地贝贡巴里后迁移了行政中心。

english: Belaga lies in Sarawak's upper Rajang country. Across the wider district, Kenyah and Kayan longhouses line the Balui and Belaga rivers, while Punan, Sekapan, Kejaman and Tanjung communities inhabit Rajang routes. Chinese traders established shops in the early twentieth century to exchange necessities with Orang Ulu communities.
simp_chinese: 美拉牙位于砂拉越拉让河上游地区。在更广阔的区境，肯雅人与加央人的长屋分布于巴鲁伊河和美拉牙河沿岸，本南、塞卡潘、克加曼与丹绒社群则生活于拉让河水路。二十世纪初，中国商人在此设店，与乌鲁人社群交换生活用品。

english: Belalcázar stands in the Córdoba countryside of southern Spain. Its heritage includes two castles, a Roman bridge and the convent of Santa Clara, founded in 1476; the late Gothic castle of the Sotomayor and Zúñiga families is a conspicuous fifteenth-century monument.
simp_chinese: 贝拉尔卡萨位于西班牙南部科尔多瓦一带。当地遗产包括两座城堡、罗马桥，以及1476年创立的圣克拉拉修道院；索托马约尔与苏尼加家族的晚期哥特式城堡，是醒目的十五世纪建筑。

english: Belang belongs to the northern Sulawesi world around Manado. In the wider region, Ternate’s sultan once collected tribute before European expansion, while Manado itself lies on a bay surrounded by mountainous country.
simp_chinese: 伯朗属于万鸦老周围的苏拉威西北部世界。在更广阔的地区，欧洲人扩张以前特尔纳特苏丹曾征收贡赋；万鸦老城本身位于群山环绕的海湾旁。

english: Belau forms the western group of the Caroline Islands, with Babeldaob its largest island and many smaller islands scattered around it. Its people had settled these waters long before Europeans mapped them. In 1696 shipwrecked islanders reached Samar and used pebbles to show the missionary Paul Klein the positions of their islands, enabling him to draw a European map. Later missionary attempts foundered in storms, while the wreck of the British Antelope in 1783 led to Prince Lee Boo's journey to London. Encounters with outsiders often began here with a ship in distress.
simp_chinese: 帛琉构成加罗林群岛的西部，以巴伯尔道布岛最大，四周散布众多小岛。欧洲人为这里绘制地图以前，岛民早已在这片海域定居。1696年，遇海难的岛民抵达萨马岛，用石子向传教士保罗·克莱因表示各岛位置，使他得以绘出欧洲地图。后来的传教航行屡遭风暴挫败，英国“羚羊号”于1783年失事，又促成利布王子赴伦敦之行。岛民与外界的接触，常从一艘遇险船只开始。

english: Palau occupies the western end of the Caroline Islands in the western Pacific. Its roughly 340 islands include Koror, the most populous island, and the larger Babeldaob.
simp_chinese: 帕劳位于西太平洋加罗林群岛的西端。其约340座岛屿包括人口最多的科罗尔岛和面积更大的巴伯尔道布岛。

english: Palau forms the western part of the Caroline Islands. Maritime migrants from Southeast Asia settled this Micronesian island world long before European maps recorded it.
simp_chinese: 帕劳构成加罗林群岛的西部。来自东南亚的海上移民，早在欧洲地图记录之前就已在这一密克罗尼西亚群岛世界定居。

english: Palau’s waters surround hundreds of islands at the western end of the Carolines. Koror and Babeldaob are the principal inhabited islands within this Micronesian seascape.
simp_chinese: 帕劳水域环绕加罗林群岛西端的数百岛屿。科罗尔与巴伯尔图阿普是这片密克罗尼西亚海景中的主要有人居住岛屿。

english: The waters around Belau belong to the western Caroline Islands. Palau’s hundreds of islands include Babeldaob and the populated Koror group. Settlement from maritime Southeast Asia joined these islands to a wider Pacific seafaring world long before European mapping.
simp_chinese: 贝劳周边水域属于加罗林群岛西部。帕劳数百岛屿包括巴伯尔道布与人口集中的科罗尔群。来自东南亚海洋地区的定居，早在欧洲制图前便将群岛纳入广阔太平洋航海世界。

english: The seas around Belau surround the western end of the Caroline Islands. Palau's islands were settled by migrants from maritime Southeast Asia around the first millennium BC, long before European charts recorded the archipelago.
simp_chinese: 贝劳周围海域环绕加罗林群岛西端。约公元前一千纪，来自东南亚海域的移民已在帕劳诸岛定居，远早于欧洲海图记录这片群岛。

english: These offshore waters surround Palau in the western Pacific's Micronesian region. Palau contains roughly 340 islands and forms the western end of the Caroline Islands, with the Philippines to the northwest and Indonesia to the south.
simp_chinese: 这片外海环绕西太平洋密克罗尼西亚地区的帕劳。帕劳约有三百四十个岛屿，构成加罗林群岛的西端，西北邻菲律宾，南接印度尼西亚方向海域。

english: The Belau offshore waters surround the western Caroline island world. Palau’s islands include Babeldaob and Koror, while settlement traditions connect the archipelago with migrants from maritime Southeast Asia.
simp_chinese: 贝劳外海环绕西加罗林岛屿世界。帕劳群岛包括巴伯尔道布与科罗尔，定居传统则将群岛与海洋东南亚移民联系起来。

english: Belaya Glina is a rural settlement in the Krasnodar country of southern Russia. It belongs to the modern Beloglinsky district and its namesake rural administrative territory.
simp_chinese: 白格利纳是俄罗斯南部克拉斯诺达尔地区的一处乡村聚落。它属于现代白格利纳区及同名乡村行政地域。

english: Belaya Kalitva belongs to the Don country on the Pontic steppe. The settlement was founded in 1703, placing its beginnings in the early eighteenth century rather than in the older medieval towns of the region. It later became the administrative center of its surrounding district. The twentieth century brought repeated changes: known in Ukrainian as Bila Kalytva, it formed part of Ukraine's Donets Governorate between 1920 and 1924 before passing into Russia within the Soviet Union. German forces occupied it from July 1942 until January 1943, and formal town status followed in 1958.
simp_chinese: 白卡利特瓦位于黑海草原的顿河地区。聚落始建于1703年，其开端属于十八世纪初，而非本区更古老的中世纪城镇时代。这里后来成为周围地区的行政中心。二十世纪带来了接连的变动：当地乌克兰语名称为比拉卡利特瓦，1920年至1924年间隶属乌克兰的顿涅茨省，随后划归苏联境内的俄罗斯。德军于1942年7月至1943年1月占领此地，1958年这里正式获得城市地位。

english: Belaya Soroka belongs to the wider Chornobyl country north of Kyiv. The regional centre was first mentioned in 1193 as a ducal hunting lodge in Kievan Rus’.
simp_chinese: 白索罗卡属于基辅以北广义的切尔诺贝利地区。地区中心于1193年首次见载，当时是基辅罗斯的公爵狩猎居所。

english: Belayan follows a tributary of the Mahakam in eastern Borneo. Its river crosses the upper Kutai Kartanegara region through a tropical-rainforest climate, joining the Mahakam near Muhuran and Kotabangun.
simp_chinese: 伯拉扬沿婆罗洲东部马哈坎河的一条支流展开。河流穿过库台卡塔内加拉上游的热带雨林气候区，在穆胡兰与哥打班贡附近汇入马哈坎河。

english: The Belcher island coast lies within Hudson Bay's great inland waters. The bay connects northeast to the Atlantic through Hudson Strait and northward toward Arctic channels.
simp_chinese: 贝尔彻群岛海岸位于哈德逊湾广阔内海之中。海湾向东北经哈德逊海峡通向大西洋，向北则接入北极水道。

english: Belchite lies on a plain southeast of Zaragoza. Alfonso the Battler founded a frontier confraternity here in 1122 to oppose al-Andalus. Later wars repeatedly reached the district, most devastatingly in 1937. After the Civil War a new town rose beside the shattered old settlement, whose ruins remained as a memorial, making the landscape itself a record of conflict and reconstruction.
simp_chinese: 贝尔奇特位于萨拉戈萨东南平原。1122年战士阿方索在此建立边境兄弟会，对抗安达卢斯。后来战事反复波及，1937年尤为惨烈。内战后新城建在破碎旧城旁，废墟被保留为纪念，使地景本身成为冲突与重建的记录。

english: Belcoo stands beside a narrow water connection in County Fermanagh, opposite Blacklion. Its name is commonly explained through that constricted passage. An older Ulster saga instead associates the place with Belcu, a chief whose trap for Conall Cernach turned against him. The story belongs to heroic tradition, adding a literary layer to the village's more practical geography of borders and waterways.
simp_chinese: 贝尔库位于弗马纳郡狭窄水道旁，与布莱克莱恩相对，地名通常从这一狭窄通道解释。更古老的阿尔斯特英雄故事则联系酋长贝尔库，他谋害科纳尔·凯尔纳赫的计策反噬自身。传说为村庄的边界与水道地理，增添了一层须与实史区分的文学记忆。

english: Beledweyne lies in Somalia's Shebelle valley near Ethiopia, with the river dividing eastern and western quarters. Its position on a vital north-south road gave it strategic weight beyond the surrounding farmland. During fighting in 1982, attacks sought control of approaches to that route. Later conflicts again reached the city, reflecting the continuing military importance of this river crossing and corridor.
simp_chinese: 贝莱德文位于邻近埃塞俄比亚的索马里谢贝利河谷，河流将城区分为东西两部。重要南北道路使其战略价值超出周围农田，1982年战斗中进攻者试图控制通道附近高地。后续冲突又反复波及，体现这一河流通道与交通节点长期的军事重要性。

english: Belekes belongs to Bashkiria between the Volga and Ural Mountains. The wider region’s ancient settlements include Bronze Age communities skilled in making metal tools, weapons and ornaments.
simp_chinese: 别列克斯属于伏尔加河与乌拉尔山之间的巴什基尔地区。广大地区古代聚落包括擅长制作金属工具、武器和饰物的青铜时代社群。

english: Belen-Ana belongs to the Sarysu country of the Kipchak steppe. The wider grasslands took their Persian name Dasht-i Qipchaq from the Kipchaks, who together with the Cumans formed a great Turkic nomadic confederation before the Mongol age.
simp_chinese: 别连阿纳属于钦察草原的萨雷苏地区。更广阔的草原以钦察人得波斯语名称达什特—钦察；蒙古时代以前，钦察人与库曼人共同形成庞大的突厥游牧联盟。

english: The Belep islands lie north of New Caledonia's main island, with Art and Pott their principal landmasses. Traditional Kanak clans marked different island territories. French colonial intervention and Catholic missions altered that society during the nineteenth century. The islands later received exiled rebels, and a leper colony temporarily displaced their inhabitants, giving this small archipelago a difficult history of forced movement.
simp_chinese: 贝莱普群岛位于新喀里多尼亚主岛以北，以阿尔岛与波特岛为主，传统卡纳克氏族各有岛域。十九世纪法国殖民介入和天主教传教改变社会，后来岛上又接收流放起义者，麻风病隔离所也曾迫使原居民迁离，使小群岛背负强制迁移的艰难历史。

english: The Belep waters form part of New Caledonia’s Melanesian archipelago. Islands, reefs and a broad lagoon system shape the surrounding sea. The barrier reef supports exceptional marine diversity around the northern approaches to Grande Terre.
simp_chinese: 贝莱普水域属于新喀里多尼亚的美拉尼西亚群岛。岛屿、礁群与广阔潟湖系统塑造海域。堡礁在大岛北部入口周边支撑丰富海洋多样性。

english: Beleuli belongs to the wider Khwarazm region of western Central Asia. Centred on the Amu Darya delta, this oasis country lies between the Kyzylkum, Karakum and Ustyurt, with historical capitals including Gurganj and Khiva.
simp_chinese: 别列乌利属于中亚西部更广阔的花剌子模地区。这片以阿姆河三角洲为中心的绿洲地区位于克孜勒库姆、卡拉库姆与乌斯秋尔特之间，历史都城包括玉龙杰赤与希瓦。

english: Belfast developed where the Farset entered the Lagan at a tidal crossing. Chartered in 1613, it grew with Scottish Presbyterian migration. Religious and political disaffection later contributed to the upheavals of 1798. Access to British capital and markets encouraged linen manufacture and shipbuilding, transforming the riverside settlement into a major industrial city while the Farset itself disappeared beneath the streets.
simp_chinese: 贝尔法斯特在法塞特河汇入拉根河的潮汐浅渡处发展，1613年获特许，苏格兰长老会移民推动增长。宗教政治不满后来促成1798年的动荡，英国资本与市场又鼓励亚麻和造船业，使河畔聚落转变为工业城市，而法塞特河本身渐被埋入街道之下。

english: Belfort guards a natural gap between the Vosges and Jura, linking the Rhine and Rhône worlds. This position attracted settlement and repeated invasions. The counts of Montbéliard granted a charter in 1307; after Austrian rule, the Treaty of Westphalia transferred it to France in 1648. Vauban enlarged its defences, turning geography into a formidable fortified gateway.
simp_chinese: 贝尔福守卫孚日与汝拉之间的天然缺口，连接莱茵河与罗讷河世界，也反复吸引定居和入侵。蒙贝利亚尔伯爵于1307年授特许；奥地利统治后，1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》使其归法国。沃邦扩建防御，将地理通道变为强大设防门户。

english: Belgaum lies near the Western Ghats in northern Karnataka. The Ratta dynasty established the town after moving from Saundatti in the late twelfth century. Its Jain Kamal Basadi, built in 1204, and inscriptions inside the fort preserve that foundation period. The older name Venugram means 'bamboo village', beneath the later city's succession of Yadava, Vijayanagara and Bahmani rulers.
simp_chinese: 贝尔高姆位于卡纳塔克北部、西高止山附近。拉塔王朝十二世纪末从绍恩达蒂迁来建城，1204年耆那教卡马尔寺和堡内铭文保存建城时期记忆。旧称韦努格拉姆意为“竹村”，其后城镇相继经历雅达瓦、毗奢耶那伽罗与巴赫曼尼统治。

english: Belgorod stands on the Seversky Donets at Russia's southern steppe margin. Feodor I ordered a fort here in 1596 as part of the defences against Crimean Tatar raids. Earlier references to a Belgorod exist, but whether they describe the same site is uncertain. The modern city's firmer origins lie in a chain of frontier works intended to protect the southern provinces.
simp_chinese: 别尔哥罗德位于北顿涅茨河畔、俄罗斯南部草原边缘。费奥多尔一世于1596年下令筑堡，构成抵御克里米亚鞑靼袭扰的防线。更早虽有同名地点记载，是否同址仍不明确；现代城市较确切的起源，属于保护南部省区的一系列边防工程。

english: Belik belongs to the country around Smolensk on the Dnieper. The regional centre, first mentioned in 863, lay on the medieval route from the Varangians to the Greeks and later headed a powerful Russian principality.
simp_chinese: 别利克属于第聂伯河畔斯摩棱斯克周边地区。地区中心最早见于863年的记载，位于中世纪从瓦良格人到希腊人的商路上，后来成为一个强大罗斯公国的都城。

english: Belin belongs to the Bazadais country of southwestern France. In the wider region, Bazas was the ancient centre of the Vasates and later an episcopal city, retaining its bishopric from at least the sixth century until 1790.
simp_chinese: 伯兰属于法国西南部的巴扎代地区。在更广阔的区域，巴扎斯曾是瓦萨特人的古代中心，后来成为主教城市，至少自六世纪至1790年保有主教座。

english: Beljamen belongs to the broad Don river country of the Eurasian steppe. The river runs from central Russia to the Sea of Azov and was important to traders connected with Byzantium. Its basin lies between the Dnieper to the west and lower Volga to the east.
simp_chinese: 别尔贾缅属于欧亚草原广阔顿河地区。顿河从俄罗斯中部流至亚速海，对与拜占庭相联系的商人十分重要。其流域位于西面第聂伯河与东面伏尔加河下游之间。

english: Belkhandi belongs to Odisha, the eastern Indian region also known as Utkala. The wider region corresponds broadly to ancient Kalinga, invaded by the Mauryan emperor Ashoka in 261 BCE.
simp_chinese: 贝尔坎迪属于印度东部的奥里萨地区，亦称乌特卡拉。更广阔的地区大致对应古代羯陵伽，孔雀王朝君主阿育王于公元前261年入侵此地。

english: Bellac lies in the rolling country northwest of Limoges, near the Vincou and Gartempe. The Monts de Blond rise to its south, while roads connect it with Poitiers and Angoulême. Its best-known literary association is Jean Giraudoux, born here in 1882. His preserved house connects a small Limousin town with the wider history of French drama and writing.
simp_chinese: 贝拉克位于利摩日西北起伏地区、万库河与加尔唐普河附近，南侧是布隆山地，道路通往普瓦捷和昂古莱姆。最著名的文学联系是1882年出生于此的让·吉罗杜，保存的故居将利穆赞小城与法国戏剧和文学史连接起来。

english: Ballari spreads across a plain of black cotton soil interrupted by striking granite heights. Two hills, Ballari Hill and Kumbara Gudda, give the settlement its distinctive setting. One side of Ballari Hill presents an unbroken monolith, while elsewhere boulders and bare ridges break the slopes. Cotton grown in the surrounding country long supported processing and weaving, before later mills transformed the scale of production. The juxtaposition of fertile dark earth and exposed stone makes this a characteristic inland Deccan landscape, where cultivated plains gather around abrupt rocky landmarks.
simp_chinese: 贝拉里铺展在黑色棉土平原上，突起的花岗岩山丘打破了平坦地势。贝拉里山与昆巴拉古达两座山，为聚落提供鲜明背景。贝拉里山一侧是一整块未断裂的巨岩，其他坡面则布满巨石与裸露山脊。周边种植的棉花，长期支撑加工和织造，后来的机器纺织厂才改变生产规模。肥沃黑土与裸岩并置，构成典型德干内陆景观：耕作平原围绕突兀的岩石地标展开。

english: Belle Isle belongs to the Newfoundland and Labrador setting of Atlantic Canada. The wider region comprises the island of Newfoundland and the continental lands of Labrador, forming Canada’s easternmost province.
simp_chinese: 贝尔岛属于加拿大大西洋沿岸的纽芬兰与拉布拉多地区。广义地区由纽芬兰岛与大陆上的拉布拉多组成，构成加拿大最东部的省份。

english: Bellême stands on a hill overlooking the Perche countryside of northwestern France. Its later history produced figures whose careers reached well beyond the small town, including musicologist Guillaume André Villoteau and merchant Aristide Boucicaut. The latter became associated with Le Bon Marché in Paris. This connection links a quiet regional hill town with the transformation of nineteenth-century urban retailing.
simp_chinese: 贝莱姆位于法国西北山丘，俯瞰佩尔什乡间。后来出生于此的人物事业远超小城，包括音乐学家纪尧姆·安德烈·维洛托和商人阿里斯蒂德·布西科；后者以巴黎乐蓬马歇商店闻名，使安静地方山城与十九世纪城市零售业变革相连。

english: Belley, the historic capital of Bugey, developed from a Roman settlement into an episcopal centre in the fifth century. Fire devastated the town in 1385, after which Savoy's dukes rebuilt and fortified it. Bugey passed to France in 1601. Wine, cheese and the birthplace of gastronome Brillat-Savarin give the town an unusually coherent association with food beside its ecclesiastical history.
simp_chinese: 贝莱是比热历史首府，由罗马聚落发展为五世纪主教中心。1385年火灾重创后，萨伏依公爵重建并设防，1601年比热归法国。葡萄酒、奶酪以及美食家布里亚—萨瓦兰出生于此，使城镇在教会历史之外，又拥有贯通生产与人物的饮食文化联系。

english: These waters face Australia’s southern coastal belt. Its inland environments range from relatively temperate country to arid landscapes.
simp_chinese: 这片水域面向澳大利亚南部沿海地带。内陆环境从较温和地区变化到干旱景观。

english: The Bellinger shore forms part of Australia's eastern coastal frontage. The wider eastern region includes Queensland, New South Wales, Victoria and Tasmania, linked by their position along the continent's ocean side.
simp_chinese: 贝林格海岸属于澳大利亚东部沿海地带。更广泛东部地区包括昆士兰、新南威尔士、维多利亚与塔斯马尼亚，以大陆临海一侧的位置相联系。

english: Bellinzona occupies a narrow Ticino valley at the southern foot of the Alps. Roads through the St Gotthard, Lukmanier, San Bernardino and other passes converge toward this gateway to the Po plain. A Roman fort established under Augustus was rebuilt and enlarged in the fourth century as northern Italy's defences strengthened. The city's long military importance therefore arose from the same geography that channelled merchants and travellers through the mountains.
simp_chinese: 贝林佐纳位于阿尔卑斯南麓狭窄的提契诺河谷，圣哥达、卢克马尼尔、圣贝纳迪诺等山口道路在这处通往波河平原的门户汇集。奥古斯都时代所筑罗马堡垒于四世纪重建扩张，以加强意大利北部防御。城镇长久军事重要性，来自同一套引导商人与旅人穿越群山的地理条件。

english: The waters around New Caledonia contain scattered islands and reefs beyond Grande Terre. The broader archipelago includes the Chesterfields in the Coral Sea, while coastal settlement reaches back to the Lapita era.
simp_chinese: 新喀里多尼亚周围水域在大地岛之外分布着零散岛屿与礁体。更广泛群岛包括珊瑚海中的切斯特菲尔德群岛，沿岸定居历史则可追溯至拉皮塔时代。

english: This coastal sea lies in the New Caledonian island region of the southwestern Pacific, east of Australia. The wider archipelago includes Grande Terre, the Loyalty Islands and the Chesterfield Islands, the last lying in the Coral Sea.
simp_chinese: 这片沿岸海域位于澳大利亚以东、西南太平洋的新喀里多尼亚群岛地区。广义群岛包括大地岛、洛亚蒂群岛以及位于珊瑚海的切斯特菲尔德群岛。

english: The Bellona waters belong to New Caledonia’s southwest Pacific island world. The wider archipelago includes Grande Terre, the Loyalty Islands and the Chesterfield group in the Coral Sea.
simp_chinese: 贝洛纳水域属于新喀里多尼亚的西南太平洋岛屿世界。广阔群岛包括大地岛、洛亚蒂群岛及珊瑚海中的切斯特菲尔德群岛。

english: The offshore reefs belong to the wider New Caledonian island world of the southwest Pacific. Grande Terre, the Loyalty Islands and remote Coral Sea groups together form an extensive Melanesian maritime region.
simp_chinese: 外海礁群属于西南太平洋更广泛的新喀里多尼亚岛屿世界。大地岛、洛亚蒂群岛与偏远珊瑚海岛群，共同构成广阔的美拉尼西亚海洋地区。

english: New Caledonia’s coastal seas include one of the world’s largest lagoon systems. Barrier reefs enclose shallow waters rich in marine life, contrasting with the open southwestern Pacific beyond them.
simp_chinese: 新喀里多尼亚近海拥有世界规模最大的潟湖系统之一。堡礁围护着生物丰富的浅水区，与外侧辽阔的西南太平洋形成差异。

english: The Bellona waters lie within New Caledonia’s wider island setting. Its surrounding archipelago includes the Chesterfield Islands in the Coral Sea and the great reef-fringed island of Grande Terre.
simp_chinese: 贝罗纳水域位于新喀里多尼亚更广阔的岛屿环境中。周边群岛包括珊瑚海的切斯特菲尔德群岛，以及被巨大礁体环绕的大地岛。

english: These waters lie in New Caledonia's southwestern Pacific island region. Grande Terre, the Loyalty Islands and the remote Chesterfield reefs form parts of a scattered archipelago extending into the Coral Sea.
simp_chinese: 贝罗纳海岸水域属于西南太平洋新喀里多尼亚岛区。大地岛、洛亚蒂群岛和偏远切斯特菲尔德礁，共同构成伸向珊瑚海的分散群岛。

english: The New Caledonian island world belongs to Melanesia. Offshore groups include the Chesterfield Islands in the Coral Sea, beyond the main island of Grande Terre.
simp_chinese: 新喀里多尼亚群岛世界属于美拉尼西亚。主岛大地岛之外的离岸群岛，包括位于珊瑚海中的切斯特菲尔德群岛。

english: The waters around New Caledonia extend westward toward the Chesterfield Islands in the Coral Sea. Grande Terre, the Loyalty Islands and scattered reef islands form parts of this Melanesian archipelago.
simp_chinese: 新喀里多尼亚周围水域向西延伸至珊瑚海切斯特菲尔德群岛。大地岛、洛亚尔蒂群岛及零散礁岛，共同构成这片美拉尼西亚群岛世界。

english: The Bellona approaches lie among the outer waters of the New Caledonian island world. The wider archipelago includes remote reefs and the Chesterfield Islands in the Coral Sea. These scattered outposts extend a maritime landscape far beyond Grande Terre itself.
simp_chinese: 贝洛纳入口位于新喀里多尼亚岛屿世界外围水域。更大群岛包括遥远礁群与珊瑚海切斯特菲尔德群岛。分散岛礁使航海景观远超大岛本身。

english: The open waters west of New Caledonia belong to the southwestern Pacific island world. James Cook sighted the wider archipelago in 1774, naming it after the Latin name of Scotland.
simp_chinese: 新喀里多尼亚以西的开阔水域属于太平洋西南部岛屿世界。詹姆斯·库克于1774年望见这片群岛，以苏格兰的拉丁名称为其命名。

english: The Bellona offshore waters belong to the southwestern Pacific around New Caledonia. Nearby island groups include the Chesterfields in the Coral Sea and the main New Caledonian island, Grande Terre.
simp_chinese: 贝洛纳外海属于新喀里多尼亚周边的西南太平洋。附近岛群包括珊瑚海中的切斯特菲尔德群岛，以及新喀里多尼亚的主岛大地岛。

english: The Bellona offshore region lies within Melanesia’s New Caledonian marine setting. The island groups stand east of Australia and southwest of Vanuatu, with scattered outliers reaching the Coral Sea.
simp_chinese: 贝洛纳外海处于美拉尼西亚的新喀里多尼亚海洋环境。群岛位于澳大利亚以东、瓦努阿图西南，零散外岛伸入珊瑚海。

english: The waters west of New Caledonia extend towards the remote islands of the Coral Sea. The Chesterfield group belongs to this scattered archipelago, far from the larger islands around Grande Terre.
simp_chinese: 新喀里多尼亚以西水域伸向偏远的珊瑚海岛屿。切斯特菲尔德群岛属于这一分散群岛，远离大地岛周围的较大岛屿。

english: The waters around New Caledonia lie east of Australia and southwest of Vanuatu. Grande Terre, the Loyalty Islands and neighbouring archipelagos form a widely scattered Melanesian island landscape.
simp_chinese: 新喀里多尼亚周边水域位于澳大利亚以东、瓦努阿图西南。大地岛、洛亚蒂群岛及邻近群岛共同构成分散的美拉尼西亚岛屿景观。

english: Bellona Reef lies in the southern Coral Sea, southeast of the Chesterfield group and west of New Caledonia. Although often grouped with the Chesterfields, it forms a geologically separate reef complex. Low sand cays and barely exposed coral make these waters a place where land and navigational danger can be difficult to distinguish. Captain Matthew Boyd named the reefs for his ship Bellona in 1793, while sailing from New South Wales toward Canton for an East India Company cargo. Their European name preserves that long commercial passage across the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 贝洛纳礁位于珊瑚海南部，在切斯特菲尔德群岛东南、新喀里多尼亚以西。它虽常被归入切斯特菲尔德群岛，地质上却是独立的礁群。低矮沙洲与几乎不露水面的珊瑚，让这里的陆地与航行危险有时难以区分。1793年，马修·博伊德船长以自己的“贝洛纳”号为礁群命名，当时他正从新南威尔士驶往广州，为东印度公司装载货物。这个欧洲名称保存了那条漫长的跨太平洋商路。

english: Belluno stands in the eastern Dolomites above the Venetian plain. The region's inhabitants allied with Rome during conflicts with the Gauls and Hannibal, before Bellunum became a Roman municipality. Its strategic position protected southern cities, while iron and copper supplied an economic purpose beyond defence. Venetic and Celtic roots were gradually absorbed into Roman institutions, leaving the Alpine town connected with both mountain resources and lowland power.
simp_chinese: 贝卢诺位于威尼斯平原上方的多洛米蒂东部。当地居民在对高卢人及汉尼拔的战争中与罗马结盟，后来贝卢努姆成为罗马自治市。战略地位保护南方城市，铁铜资源则赋予军事之外的经济功能。威尼蒂与凯尔特根基逐渐融入罗马制度，将阿尔卑斯资源与低地权力连接起来。

english: Belmonte belongs to Iberia’s southern interior plateau country. The wider Meseta Central is ringed by mountains and contains the headwaters of many rivers that escape through gaps in its surrounding ranges.
simp_chinese: 贝尔蒙特属于伊比利亚南部内陆高原地区。更广阔的中央高原被群山环绕，众多河流发源于此，穿过周围山脉的缺口流出。

english: Beloe belongs to the Lake Beloye country of northern Russia. The nearby town of Beloozero, now Belozersk, appears in the Primary Chronicle under 862, while the surrounding region retained a strong Finnic presence into the eleventh century.
simp_chinese: 别洛耶属于俄罗斯北部的白湖地区。附近的别洛奥泽罗、今别洛泽尔斯克在《往年纪事》中于862年见载，周围地区直到十一世纪仍有强大的芬兰语族群存在。

english: Belogorye belongs to the wider Siberian Tatar country associated with Qashliq. That fortress on the Irtysh became the capital of the Khanate of Sibir in the sixteenth century, before Yermak’s Cossacks seized it in 1582 and Tobolsk rose nearby in 1587.
simp_chinese: 别洛戈里耶属于与卡什利克相联系的西伯利亚鞑靼广大地域。额尔齐斯河畔的卡什利克堡于十六世纪成为西伯利亚汗国都城，1582年被叶尔马克的哥萨克攻占，1587年附近又兴起托博尔斯克。

english: Beloozero takes its name from White Lake, whose southern shore supports the town. The Primary Chronicle includes it among the settlements known in 862, although the legendary rulers attached to that account cannot simply be accepted as historical figures. The northern lake country also developed a distinctive religious culture. Two celebrated thirteenth-century icons made here, the Virgin of the White Lake and Saints Peter and Paul, stand between Novgorodian and northern styles. Later churches and neighbouring monasteries added to a landscape where lake travel, settlement and sacred art were closely connected.
simp_chinese: 别洛奥泽罗得名于白湖，城镇坐落在湖南岸。《往年纪事》将它列入862年已知的聚落，但叙事中的传说统治者不能直接视为可靠史实。北方湖区也形成了独特的宗教文化。这里制作的两幅著名十三世纪圣像——白湖圣母与圣彼得和圣保罗——呈现出介于诺夫哥罗德与北方画派之间的风格。后世教堂及邻近修道院，又为这片湖上交通、聚落与宗教艺术紧密相连的大地增添了层次。

english: Belorechensk is a town in the Krasnodar country of southern Russia. It shares its name with another settlement in the Kirov region.
simp_chinese: 别洛列琴斯克是俄罗斯南部克拉斯诺达尔地区的一座城镇。基洛夫地区另有一座同名聚落。

english: Beloretsk lies on the Belaya River in Bashkortostan. Its documented industrial foundation dates to 1762, when merchants Ivan Tverdyshev and Ivan Myasnikov established an ironworks after purchasing extensive land from local Bashkirs. The town's growth thus belongs to the expansion of metallurgy into the Urals. Orthodox Christian and Muslim communities later shared a settlement whose name and livelihood remained closely connected with river and iron.
simp_chinese: 别洛列茨克位于巴什科尔托斯坦别拉亚河畔。1762年，商人伊万·特维尔德舍夫和伊万·米亚斯尼科夫向当地巴什基尔人购入大片土地，建立铁厂，留下明确工业起点。城市兴起因而属于冶金业向乌拉尔扩展的历史。后来东正教与穆斯林社群共居，地方生计仍与河流、钢铁紧密相连。

english: Belosaraysk Gulf forms part of the shallow Sea of Azov. Rivers carry sediment that builds spits and coastal lagoons, while the Kerch Strait provides the narrow outlet to the Black Sea.
simp_chinese: 别洛萨赖斯克湾属于浅水的亚速海。河流搬运泥沙，形成沙嘴与沿岸潟湖，刻赤海峡则是通往黑海的狭窄出口。

english: Belozerye belongs to the wider Vyatka river country. The Vyatka rises in northern Udmurtia and joins the Kama after a long course through Russia’s interior; its waters freeze from early November into late April and support plentiful fish, including pike, perch and bream.
simp_chinese: 别洛泽里耶属于广阔的维亚特卡河地区。维亚特卡河发源于乌德穆尔特北部，穿行俄罗斯内陆后汇入卡马河；河水从十一月初封冻至四月下旬，养育着狗鱼、河鲈和鲂等丰富鱼类。

english: Belur lies on the undulating Mysore Plateau of southern Karnataka. The plateau is bounded by the Western Ghats to the west and south, and carries much of the Kaveri’s course within Karnataka.
simp_chinese: 贝鲁尔位于卡纳塔克南部起伏的迈索尔高原。高原的西面与南面为西高止山，卡韦里河在卡纳塔克境内的大部分河段流经其上。
